prTitle: Add guest management functionality to existing bookings
head: 92f44dcea7ff19e9123a30c63c167a2938df5a55

prOriginalConhecido.nota: Found via the commit history of addGuests.handler.ts (first commit baa9045af7, 'feat: ability to add guests via app.cal.com/bookings (#14740)'). PR headRefOid equals the benchmark head and the merged handler is byte-identical to the benchmark head. The repo calcom/cal.com now redirects to calcom/cal.diy.

tps.bug: Adding guests ignores `seatsPerTimeSlot`, so a seated event can exceed its configured capacity; reject when attendees plus new guests exceed the seat limit.
tps.evidenciaOpus: The new addGuests.handler.ts:74-106 creates attendees with no check on booking.eventType.seatsPerTimeSlot (it only passes it into evt at line 145), and the UI (BookingListItem) exposes Add guests without gating seated events, so attendees can exceed the configured seat capacity.
tps.evidenciaAstra: packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.handler.ts:74-106 filters email addresses and inserts attendees without checking capacity; seatsPerTimeSlot is only forwarded afterward at line 145. The authenticated mutation is exposed without a seated-event restriction in packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/_router.tsx:79-94, allowing additional attendees even when a seated booking is full.
